latestVersion.changelog:
Best Video Editor Free — Initial Release

- Launches a cloud-powered AI video editor for fast, subscription-free video editing and export.
- Allows upload of MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files (up to 500MB) for automated AI edits.
- Supports quick edits—trim, transitions, and 1080p export—in about 1-2 minutes per clip.
- Handles setup, authentication, and session management automatically on first use.
- Includes easy-to-use commands for uploading, exporting, checking credits, and previewing edits.
- Ideal for students and casual creators seeking polished videos without advanced editing skills.
